package.name: wojtek_spectacles_bridge
package.description:
Snap Spectacles pinch-drag joystick -> /cmd_vel bridge. A plain WebSocket server (ws://<host>:8765/ws) that the Spectacles Lens (Snap_Spectacles/Assets/PinchDragNavigator.ts) connects to over the "wojtek-net" hotspot, streaming {"vx","wz"} JSON at ~10 Hz. Republishes the same /cmd_vel surface the gamepad, web console, and text_commander use. Dead-man contract matches wojtek_teleop/text_commander.py: one zero Twist on timeout, then silence. Started only by hand (ros2 run), not wired into any launch file or wojtek_bringup dependency.
Experimental: first pass, not yet run against the real robot.
